How does deal registration work, and how is it protected?

Every deal registration is processed by your Channel Business Manager (CBM). Once you submit a DR, all stakeholders are notified, and you have 15 days to schedule a meeting on the account. If no meeting is set in that window, the lead opens up to others, with stakeholders notified at the 15- and 30-day marks.

Once a meeting is confirmed and the DR is approved, the lead converts to an opportunity assigned to your Torq AE, and your registration protects that deal for 90 days from the original submission date. You’ll get a heads-up at 75 days before expiration, and the DR can be extended for another 90 days with your Torq AE’s approval.
What co-marketing and MDF investment is available?

We don’t run a formal MDF program today, but we still invest in our partners’ marketing. Bring us the initiative you want to get going — campaigns, events, co-branded content, field activity — and we’ll work with you to make it happen.
